summary: Schools is an entirely new product area: admin-curated schools (per the board note 'added from the WAWU dashboard', not a new account type) with priced courses and dated intakes with seat caps, enroll-and-pay-from-wallet with a PIN, a report of the enrollee's details sent to the school, and an alternative outbound tracked link for which the school pays WAWU a commission. Nothing in the backend models a school, a priced course, an intake or a payee that is not a creator; LearnCourse/CourseEnrollment is a different product (free-slot handoff, still gated on the removed subscription) and EventReferral attributes inbound on-platform sales, so neither fits beyond reusable patterns (Product.stock race-safe decrement, EventOrder commission snapshot). The schools backend surface is XL overall, and blocked on rulings: who receives enrollment money and at what split (current product has one 85/15 split; canvas shows 'No fee' and money 'to Greenfield'), the commission rate, and school KYB. Shop on canvas is WAWU's own first-party gear catalogue ('Approve ₦263,000 to WAWU Shop'), which matches the backend Product model with no seller and is not the WAWUBasket/WAWUBeauty handoff; backend and web already serve almost every shop screen, but the web shop is switched off (SHOP_LIVE = false, 12 Sep 2026) and the 'Sell on WAWU · List your gear and products' banner implies third-party sellers the model cannot hold. Shop gaps are pay-from-wallet + PIN (orders are Flutterwave card charges today), back-in-stock alerts, refund execution, and order help. The biggest risk across both flows is pay-from-wallet: it needs every buyer to have a spendable wallet and a debit-to-merchant path under a provider (Fintava per the design rule vs Flutterwave today), which reopens the custody/CBN question the current product notes say to check before building.
